class Animal:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
    def speak(self):
        print(self.name, "makes a sound")
class Dog(Animal): # Dog inherits from Animal
    def fetch(self):
        print(self.name, "fetches the ball")
d = Dog("Seru")
d.speak() # from the parent class
d.fetch() # its own method
Note: Inheritance lets a child class reuse the parent's code. Types: single, multilevel, multiple, hierarchical, hybrid.
